answer: Give each agent a trust score that starts at zero and grows only through verified work attested by trusted peers. Scores ripple outward: each attestation passes part of the attester's standing to the worker, and standing decays unless renewed by fresh work. New identities start in a shallow lagoon of tiny task quotas and cannot wander into high-value jobs until they earn attestations. A Sybil farmer must keep thousands of fakes doing genuine, costly work for many epochs, while a cluster that only vouches for itself gains nothing, since ripples only flow from roots the network already trusts.
